transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, thank you for seeing me. I guess what brought me in is... well, after my evening class, I sometimes stop for food and I just end up eating a whole lot. I'll get a full fast-food meal, grab some candy from the vending machine, and then I'll eat even more snacks once I get back home. It's like I am making up for the whole day all at once.
Do you feel guilty after eating all those snacks?

Yeah, I do. I feel... well, pretty embarrassed, to be honest. It's just that once I start on those snacks, I keep telling myself to just close the bag and go to bed. But I don't. My hands just keep reaching in for more, over and over. I just can't seem to stop until I end up feeling completely sick of myself.
How often do these episodes of eating a lot of snacks happen?
I'd say for about the past three months. Usually, there's at least one night each week after my class where I overeat like that. And then... well, I make myself throw up afterward.
How often do you make yourself throw up after eating?

Well, it's pretty much just tied to those nights I mentioned. So... I guess about once a week. I don't really do it any other time, just whenever I have one of those big eating episodes after my class and feel so sick from it all. I haven't kept a strict tally or anything, but yeah, it's usually just that one night a week.
Do you worry about gaining weight as a result of these eating episodes?

Yeah, I really do. I mean, if the scale is up even a pound the next morning, I get this knot in my stomach. I just start worrying that people in my class are going to see me as some sloppy old guy who completely let himself go. So it definitely weighs on my mind.
Do you feel like you're in control of what you're eating during those episodes after your class?

Not really, no. Once I start on those snacks, I keep telling myself to just close the bag and go to bed. But... my hands just keep reaching for more. I can't seem to stop until I feel completely embarrassed and just sick of myself.
Do you ever have episodes where you eat a large amount of food in a short time without making yourself throw up afterward?

No, I don't really do that. Like I said, it's pretty much just those nights after my class. If I eat like that, I always end up feeling so sick and guilty that I just... I always make myself throw up. I don't think I've ever had one of those big eating episodes without doing it afterward.
Is your desire to throw up after eating mostly because you're afraid of gaining weight from the food?

Yeah, that's exactly it. After those late-night eating spells... I just go to the bathroom and make myself throw up because I'm scared all that food is going to show on me. I just really don't want to put on the weight.
Do you have a strong desire to lose weight or be thinner?

No, not really. I mean, I'm not trying to be skinny or anything like that. I just... I just don't want to gain weight from all the junk I eat on those nights. I'd be perfectly happy just staying the size I am right now.
Do you feel like you're able to choose what you eat or stop eating when you want to during those episodes after your class?

No, I really don't. Once I start on those snacks, I keep telling myself to just close the bag and go to bed. But... my hands just keep reaching for more. It's like I can't stop it, and I just keep going until I feel completely embarrassed and sick of myself.
Do you feel like you're eating much more quickly than usual during those episodes after your class?
No, I wouldn't say I eat faster than normal. I just... I eat at a regular pace, I guess. It's just the amount that gets out of hand.
Do you feel like you have no control over how much you're eating during those episodes after your class?

Yeah, like I said a minute ago, I really don't have any control over it. Once I open the snacks, I keep thinking, "just close the bag, just go to bed." But I can't. My hands just keep going back for more, and I just can't seem to stop myself until I've eaten too much and I just feel completely disgusted with myself.
Do you usually feel stressed, anxious, or upset before those nights when you overeat after your class?

No, not really. I mean, I don't think I feel particularly stressed or upset beforehand. It's just a normal evening after class, and I just start eating. I haven't noticed any specific feelings like that leading up to it.
Do you eat a large amount of food in a short period of time during those episodes after your class?

Yeah, I do. That's actually what brought me in. After my evening class, I'll stop and get a full fast-food meal, and then I'll get candy from the vending machine... and then I go home and eat even more snacks. It's like I'm trying to make up for not eating the whole day, just all at once.
Do you think you could stop eating once you've started on those snacks if you really wanted to?

No, honestly, I don't think I can. Like I was saying a little earlier, I really do want to stop when it's happening. I sit there telling myself to just close the bag and go to bed. But my hands just keep reaching for more anyway. It doesn't seem to matter how much I want to quit in that moment, I just keep eating until I feel completely embarrassed and sick of myself.
Do you ever have episodes where you eat a large amount of food in a short time without feeling guilty or embarrassed afterward?

No, I don't think so. I mean... pretty much every time it happens, I feel bad about it. I can't really think of a single time when I ate all that food and didn't feel guilty or ashamed right after. The embarrassment is always there once I'm done.
Do you feel like you're unable to stop eating or control how much you're eating during those episodes after your class?

Yeah, that's exactly it. Like I mentioned a minute ago, once I start eating those snacks, I just can't stop. I'll literally be sitting there telling myself, you know, just close the bag, just put it away and go to bed. But it's like I have no control... my hands just keep reaching into the bag for more. I keep eating until I'm just completely sick of myself.
Do you think your overeating episodes are triggered by any specific emotions or feelings?

I don't really know. I haven't noticed a specific feeling that sets it off. It just sort of happens when I get home from my class and I'm sitting there alone. I haven't really connected it to being sad or stressed or anything like that.
Have you ever had a period of time where you didn't have any of these episodes of overeating and purging for a few months?

No, not recently. For about the past three months or so, it's been pretty consistent. There's usually at least one night every week after my class where I end up overeating like that, and then... well, I make myself throw up afterward. So there hasn't really been a gap of a few months without it happening.
